ops.loadingHours: The car lifts for Concord Ballroom and Hana are 2.4 m high, 2.46 m deep and 6.9 m wide, and the car lift for Eminence Hall is 2.1 m high, 7.2 m deep and 2.1 m wide (as stated in the official PDFs; March 31, 2025 edition).
ops.parking: The hotel car park has 509 spaces (including wheelchair-accessible spaces) and is open 24 hours. Vehicles up to 2.1 m high, 6 m long, 2.08 m wide and 5 t in weight can enter. Vehicles up to 2.8 m high can enter from the entrance on the Tokyo Metropolitan Government side, but parking spaces are limited, so tell the bellman or the parking attendant when entering. The general rate is 400 yen per 30 minutes, with a maximum of 2,000 yen for up to 24 hours. Banquet use is free for up to 3.5 hours (hand the entry ticket to the venue staff), and exhibitions that use a banquet room are free for up to 2 hours.
ops.waitingRooms: Tama and Sagami on the 42nd floor (67㎡ each) can also be used as waiting rooms for entertaining visitors, for example with an aperitif service.
ops.catering: Bringing in food and drink to serve to attendees is prohibited (unless the hotel gives permission). Decorations, entertainment, costumes, gifts, flowers, photography and the like must use companies designated by the hotel; if a company other than the designated ones is used, the preparation and bring-in fees must be discussed with the hotel in advance (Banquet Room Terms of Use, last revised November 1, 2025).
ops.restaurants: The hotel's restaurants are the French restaurant Meilleur and Private Dining on the 44th floor of the Main Tower; on the 2nd floor, the Super Buffet Glass Court, the Chinese dining Nan-en and the all-day dining Jurin; on the 7th floor of the Main Tower, the teppanyaki Yamanami, the tempura Shun and the sushi Kyubey; and on the 1st floor, the soba Fumotoya. Bars and lounges are the Sky Lounge Aurora on the 45th floor of the Main Tower, the Main Bar Brillant on the 2nd floor, and the Cocktail & Tea Lounge and the Art Lounge Duet on the 3rd floor.
